# eufy

> > eufy provides smart home security and cleaning solutions including AI-powered cameras, PoE NVR systems, video doorbells, smart locks, and robot vacuums with local storage and privacy-first features.

eufy specializes in consumer and business security products featuring advanced AI detection, color night vision, and local storage capabilities. Their product ecosystem includes the HomeBase 3 hub, SoloCam wireless cameras, S4 Max NVR systems, Video Doorbell E340, smart locks, and Omni series robot vacuums with Forever Power technology.

## Key Topics

- AI Detection & Local AI Processing
- PoE NVR Security Systems
- HomeBase 3 Hub
- Color Night Vision Technology
- Forever Power (Solar & Battery)
- SoloCam Wireless Cameras
- eufyCam S3 Pro
- Video Doorbell E340 (Dual Camera)
- S4 Max NVR System
- Smart Locks & Access Control
- Robot Vacuum Omni Series (S1 Pro, E28, X10 Pro)
- Local Storage & Privacy
- 4K & 2K Resolution Surveillance
- Business Security Solutions

## Security Camera Systems

- [SoloCam - Wireless Security with Advanced Features](https://www.eufy.com/solocam): SoloCam wireless security cameras with 3K resolution, AI detection, solar
- [S4 Max NVR Security System | World's 1st with Local AI](https://www.eufy.com/s4-max-nvr-security-system-worlds-1st-with-local-ai-1): S4 Max PoE NVR system with Local AI, 360° PTZ, and 4K surveillance
- [Wall Light Cams](https://www.eufy.com/wall-light-camera): 2K HD wall light cameras with motion-activated lighting and night vision

## Video Doorbells & Smart Locks

- [eufy Video Doorbell | Dual Cameras & 2K Resolution](https://www.eufy.com/copy-video-doorbell-1763033169784): Video Doorbell E340 with dual cameras, 2K resolution, and night vision
- [eufy Smart Locks: Secure Your Home with Confidence](https://www.eufy.com/eufy-smart-lock): Smart locks with remote control, long battery life, and BHMA certification

## Business Security Solutions

- [Smart Business Solutions- Enhance Your Workplace](https://www.eufy.com/ca/poe-smart-business): PoE NVR Security Systems for business and professional monitoring
